item.title: Musashi Kyuryo National Government Park: A Vast Family Nature Park — Guide
item.description: Musashi Kyuryo National Government Park is one of only a handful of national government parks in Japan, a designation reflecting its scale and significance, spanning a vast area of forest, meadow and wetland. The park offers extensive cycling paths, large playground areas for children, seasonal flower fields, and quiet woodland trails, making it a popular destination for family outings and a peaceful contrast to Saitama’s more historic sightseeing spots. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Namegawa, Saitama Hours ~9:30–17:00 (seasonal variation) Admission Around ¥450 (adult) Time needed 2–4 hours Best time Spring (flowers); autumn (foliage); year-round for families What to See Extensive cycling paths through forest and meadow.
